blocks.text: For applicants with tissue or mechanical valve replacement(s):
blocks.html: For applicants with tissue or mechanical valve replacement(s):

blocks.text: INITIAL CONSIDERATION:
blocks.html: INITIAL CONSIDERATION:

blocks.text: - First- or Second-Class Applicants: Applicants may be reviewed by the Federal Air Surgeon's (FAS) Cardiology Panel or FAS Cardiology Consultant and must have a 6-month recovery period after procedure to ensure stabilization.
blocks.html: • First- or Second-Class Applicants: Applicants may be reviewed by the Federal Air Surgeon's (FAS) Cardiology Panel or FAS Cardiology Consultant and must have a 6-month recovery period after procedure to ensure stabilization.

blocks.text: - Multiple heart valve replacement(s): Applicants who have received multiple heart valve replacements may be considered.
blocks.html: • Multiple heart valve replacement(s): Applicants who have received multiple heart valve replacements may be considered.

blocks.text: - Ross Procedure: The FAA may consider certification of all classes of applicants who have undergone a Ross Procedure (pulmonic valve transplanted to the aortic position and pulmonic valve replaced by a bioprosthesis).
blocks.html: • Ross Procedure: The FAA may consider certification of all classes of applicants who have undergone a Ross Procedure (pulmonic valve transplanted to the aortic position and pulmonic valve replaced by a bioprosthesis).

blocks.text: - Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) Procedure: TAVR may also be considered for any class.
blocks.html: • Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) Procedure: TAVR may also be considered for any class.

blocks.text: - The following information must be submitted for all classes:
blocks.html: • The following information must be submitted for all classes:

blocks.text:
- 1. Copies of all hospital/medical records pertaining to the valve replacement:
- Admission History & Physical (H&P);
- Discharge summary;
- Operative report with valve information (make, model, serial number and size); and
- Pathology report
- 2. A current report from the treating cardiologist regarding the status of the cardiac valve replacement. It should address your general cardiovascular condition, any symptoms of valve or heart failure, any related abnormal physical findings, and must substantiate satisfactory recovery and cardiac function without evidence of embolic phenomena, significant arrhythmia, structural abnormality, or ischemic disease.
- 3. If on warfarin (Jantoven), the attending physician must confirm stability without complications. Report must include warfarin (Jantoven) dose history, schedule, and International Normalized Ratio (INR) values (monthly for the past 6-month period of observation; must be within acceptable range).
- 4. Current 24-hour Holter monitor evaluation to include select representative tracings.
- 5. Current M-mode, 2-dimensional, and M-Mode Doppler echocardiogram, specifically including chamber dimensions and valvular gradients. Submit the video resulting from this study on CD-ROM in DICOM compatible format.
- 6. If cardiac catheterization and coronary angiography have been performed, all reports AND films must be submitted, including a copy of the cineangiogram on CD-ROM in DICOM compatible format.

blocks.text: FOLLOW-UP CERTIFICATION:
blocks.html: FOLLOW-UP CERTIFICATION:

blocks.text: After initial certification, all classes are usually followed at 12-month intervals with the following requirements:
blocks.html: After initial certification, all classes are usually followed at 12-month intervals with the following requirements:

• Current clinical status report from your treating cardiologist;
  • Standard resting ECG; (actual LEGIBLE tracing);
  • Doppler echocardiogram report; and
  • If used, a warfarin (Jantoven) status report: Include dose; monthly INRs; any complications from treatment and subsequent actions taken.

blocks.text: Note:
blocks.html: Note:

blocks.text:
- Holter and GXT may be required periodically, if clinically indicated.
- All classes may be eligible for an AASI Cardiac Valve Replacement .
- This includes TAVR or other SINGLE valve replacement.
- If any new valve replacement since their Special Issuance, the AME must defer.

- Keep a copy of all documents and media submitted as a safeguard against loss.

blocks.text: Protocol for Cardiovascular Evaluation (CVE)
blocks.html: Protocol for Cardiovascular Evaluation (CVE)

blocks.text: An FAA CVE is comprised of Cardiology Evaluation + Lab Testing
blocks.html: An FAA CVE is comprised of Cardiology Evaluation + Lab Testing

blocks.text: Cardiology Evaluation should be submitted in the form of a current, detailed Clinical Progress Note and include:
blocks.html: Cardiology Evaluation should be submitted in the form of a current, detailed Clinical Progress Note and include:

• A detailed summary of the history of any cardiac or co-morbid condition(s);
  • Personal and family medical history including premature heart disease;
  • Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any);
  • Clinical cardiac and general physical exam findings;
  • Results of any testing performed;
  • Diagnosis;
  • Assessment and plan (prognosis); and
  • Follow-up.

blocks.text: It must specifically include:
blocks.html: It must specifically include:

• If hospitalization or procedure, include a summary of events that led to the cardiac intervention(s) or treatment;
  • A statement regarding the individual’s functional capacity and if they have been cleared to return to regular activity;
  • Attempts to meet the guidelines for modifiable risk factors (such as lipid levels, aspirin use, beta-blocker use, and smoking cessation per the American College of Cardiology and American Heart Association); and
  • Prognosis for incapacitation.

blocks.text: Labs must be current (performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam) and include:
blocks.html: Labs must be current (performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam) and include:

• Hemoglobin A1c;
  • Blood lipid profile with total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, and triglycerides; and
  • INR monthly readings if on warfarin (Jantoven)

blocks.text: Note: CVE does not include stress testing. See the corresponding disposition table or FAA letter to identity which type of stress test (if any) is required.
blocks.html: Note: CVE does not include stress testing. See the corresponding disposition table or FAA letter to identity which type of stress test (if any) is required.
